highlights:
In the news release, TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions Appoints Sue Schick as Chief Executive Officer, issued 11-Aug-2026 by TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions over PR Newswire, we are advised by the company that changes have been made. The complete, corrected release follows, with additional details at the end:
...
### TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions Appoints Sue Schick as Chief Executive Officer
...
LAKE MARY, Fla., Aug. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions, a physician-led specialty condition management company, today announced that Sue Schick has been appointed Chief Executive Officer effective August 3rd. Schick succeeds founder Eric Pezzi, who is retiring from the CEO role after leading the company since its founding in 2014. Pezzi will remain closely involved with TurningPoint as a member of the company's board of directors.

# TurnPoint Services Appoints Greg Bochicchio as Chief Executive Officer
...
## TurnPoint Services Appoints Greg Bochicchio as Chief
...
Louisville, Ky – TurnPoint Services, the industry leader in applied technology, growth, diversified service lines, and profitability for residential HVAC, electrical and plumbing services, and its Board of Directors has appointed Greg Bochicchio as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective February 27, 2026. Greg will succeed Kurt Bratton, who will become a special advisor to the Board of Directors following his retirement at the end of February.
